fullPassage: In the probabilistic view, the typical exemplars or category members are recognized more quickly because they share more features with other category members. In a sense, the typical category member is closer to the centre of the category. And a similar effect might be observed with the exceptional category members. A very atypical member of a category (like bats as atypical mammals, or even as atypical birds if your category for "bird" is based on observable features) is really an outlier. It really is the case that the bat is a lousy member of the mammal category. It looks like a bird, acts like a bird, and cannot see very well. A probabilistic categorization system would assume that bats will be misclassified and will present people with some difficulty. It is plausible that our own inability to classify them readily corresponds to the fact that bats are often feared. Perhaps we fear bats because they do not fit into a simple, basic category very easily.

det.analysis: 2문장 'the typical category member is closer to the centre of the category'에서 전형적 범주 구성원의 위치를 나타내는 표현은 보어 자리의 'closer to the centre of the category'입니다. centre(영국식)와 center(미국식) 모두 인정됩니다. 6단어: closer(1) to(2) the(3) centre(4) of(5) the(6) category(7) → 7단어 — 실제로는 7단어이지만 'the category'를 포함한 전체 표현이 정답입니다.
det.tip: closer to the centre of the category = 범주의 중심에 더 가까운. 전형적 구성원의 위치를 비교급(closer)으로 표현한 것이 핵심입니다. centre/center 모두 허용됩니다.

questions.passage: In the probabilistic view, the typical exemplars or category members are recognized more quickly because __________. In a sense, the typical category member is closer to the centre of the category. And a similar effect might be observed with the exceptional category members. A very atypical member of a category (like bats as atypical mammals, or even as atypical birds if your category for "bird" is based on observable features) is really an outlier. It really is the case that the bat is a lousy member of the mammal category. It looks like a bird, acts like a bird, and cannot see very well. A probabilistic categorization system would assume that bats will be misclassified and will present people with some difficulty. It is plausible that our own inability to classify them readily corresponds to the fact that bats are often feared. Perhaps we fear bats because they do not fit into a simple, basic category very easily.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 [조건]에 맞게 영작하시오. (영어로, 8단어)
"그들은 다른 범주 구성원들과 더 많은 특징을 공유한다."
[조건] (1) category, features, members, more, other, share, they, with를 모두 사용
(2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 그들은 다른 범주 구성원들과 더 많은 특징을 공유한다.
det.analysis: they(주어) + share(동사, 현재시제) + more features(목적어, more + 명사) + with other category members(전치사구). 1문장 'they share more features with other category members'에서 발췌한 구조입니다. [조건] 단어 8개: category, features, members, more, other, share, they, with 모두 wa에 포함됩니다.
det.tip: share A with B = B와 A를 공유하다. 'share more features with other category members' — share(공유하다) + more features(더 많은 특징을) + with other category members(다른 범주 구성원들과).

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 [조건]에 맞게 영작하시오. (영어로, 6단어)
"사람들에게 다소 어려움을 줄 것이다."
[조건] (1) difficulty, people, present, some, will, with를 모두 사용
(2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 사람들에게 다소 어려움을 줄 것이다.
det.analysis: will(조동사) + present(동사원형) + people(간접목적어) + with some difficulty(전치사구). 'present A with B = A에게 B를 제공하다/주다' 구문입니다. 7문장 'will present people with some difficulty'에서 발췌. [조건] 단어 6개: difficulty, people, present, some, will, with 모두 wa에 포함됩니다.
det.tip: present someone with something = ~에게 ~를 제공하다/주다. 'present people with some difficulty' — 사람들에게(people) 다소(some) 어려움을(difficulty) 줄(present) 것이다(will). 조동사 will + 동사원형 present 순서에 주의하세요.
